findings.text: tensor_benchmark_cases has no row for this anchor: the platform benchmark referee cannot adjudicate and the case_pool row still says status='dispatched'. Audit adjudicated against the in-code closed form + case_pool tol_policy (<2%). Registry gap, not a mission defect.

The merge gate dropped 3 files from the mission branch (artifacts/result.json, artifacts/*.png, logs/*.log) -> the canonical main tree has the harness but not the produced artifacts; they are regenerable and the auditor regenerated them bit-identically, so this is non-blocking, but the board gate must re-run repro_cmd rather than expect stored artifacts.

The acceptance metric is the least-squares mean of v(t) over ~195 tangential-oscillation periods, so discrete error is averaged out and any consistent integrator lands at ~1e-6. The claim must not be read as 'solver accuracy 1e-6'. The genuinely discriminating quantities are the oscillation amplitude (0.94% at the base dt, first-order convergent 3.93%->0.94%->0.23%->0.058%) and the mu_r branch (4e-6 against a torque-dependent reference). Both are present and pass.

Reference is classical rigid-body closed form plus Ai et al. 2011 model relations only; the paper's table values were not machine-accessible (declared in provenance.reference.access_note and section 1). No experimental anchor. => L5 (scientific/literature-anchored result) refused.

checks_not_run: no cross-validation against the 3-D solver IceDEM3D (the case exercises a dedicated 1-DOF incline harness; 3-D pair rolling is covered by other anchors, not by this one)
no experimental/material validation (none applicable: the reference is a rigid-body kinematic identity, not a material law)
multi-sphere / clump rolling on an incline not covered by this case
level_rationale: L4 = complete benchmark case + error analysis + reproducible. Present: pre-registered design, base acceptance point, 4-point dt convergence, 3-point window sensitivity, 3-point stiffness invariance, rolling-resistance branch, critical-angle point, 2 negative controls, 6 CI tests, bit-identical auditor reproduction, error budget every item < 1% (gate 2%). L5 refused: no external literature/experimental anchor (F4). L3 is satisfied too (the rolling law is the shipped single implementation consumed by contact_tangential/ball_ball_rolling) but the case's own instrument is a harness, which is why the L4 evidence rests on the benchmark, not on a 3-D solve.
external_anchor_note: Ai, Chen, Rotter, Ooi (2011) Powder Technology 206, 269-282, doi:10.1016/j.powtec.2010.11.003 is used ONLY for the model relations (M_r = mu_r |F_n| r_eff, theta_c = arctan(mu_r)); the PDF/table values were not available in the environment and are NOT claimed (machine-checkable in provenance.reference.access_note). The numerical anchor is the classical closed form a = g (sin t - mu_r cos t)/(1 + I/(mR^2)), evaluated in-code.
